body.head: codex/require-service-owned-data-roots
body.title: Require service-owned data roots independently of Git layout
body.body:
The resolver rejected a services section when it was its own Git checkout, while accepting arbitrary roots outside a checkout. Require the selected existing real services section above data/, refuse home .local, installed-code and symlink-backed data roots, and keep config/environment/argv precedence and the immutable result. Applications use their existing explicit owner selection.

Version 0.3.0 marks the intentional change to formerly admitted app/arbitrary roots. All four source test families pass: 49 tests, no failures or skips. The five curated records include independent source receiving, exact base/parent identities, named native observations and preserved earlier test failures; raw captures stay in owned logs.

This is source-only integration. The shared npm runner/dependency closure, package publication, CSE dependency update, deployed explicit owner bindings and actual federation use remain unreceived. CDE ownerDataRoot takes section/data; this resolver returns the section above data. No installed or live-host change is claimed.
